dna.prompt: office male character with laptop on hand
dna.name: Office Laptop Man

equipment.body: light blue office shirt with dark gray tie and charcoal vest

directions.up: Seen from behind in top-down pixel-art view, the chibi office worker shows neatly parted dark brown hair, a light blue shirt under a charcoal vest, and straight dark gray slacks. His right arm is bent slightly as if holding a laptop at his side, with clean, simple GBC sprite shading.
directions.down: Seen from the front in top-down view, he has a calm brown-eyed face, short side-part hair, and a neat office look with a dark tie, light blue shirt, and charcoal vest. The laptop is held in one hand at chest height, with slim slacks and a visible ID badge lanyard.
directions.left: In left-facing side profile, the sprite shows a short side-part haircut, a small brown eye, and a slim office silhouette. The left arm hangs near the body while the other supports the laptop, which appears as a flat dark rectangle. The shirt, vest, and slacks are cleanly blocked in pixel layers.
directions.right: In right-facing side profile, the office man’s face is simplified into a chibi nose and brown eye, with dark brown hair swept neatly to one side. His arm bends to hold the laptop, while the vest, tie, and slacks form a tidy business outfit with minimal GBC-style shading.
